actionable_steps.citation: Develop Love for God — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-08-18
actionable_steps.step: Don't waste time — time wasted is life wasted, for Time is God.

actionable_steps.citation: Give up selfishness and strive for selfrealisation — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 39 (2006), 2006-09-27
actionable_steps.step: Spend even the little time at your disposal in contemplation on the Soham (I am God) mantra.

actionable_steps.citation: Adhere to Truth: Realise Divinity within — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 30 (1997), 1997-07-18
actionable_steps.step: Cut excessive talk and idle gossip — they waste both time and energy.

actionable_steps.citation: Right use of Time — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 30 (1997), 1997-04-07
actionable_steps.step: Use time always for right purposes — that is the foremost duty of every man.

actionable_steps.citation: Cultivate Satwic Qualities Right from Childhood — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 38 (2005), 2005-10-22
actionable_steps.step: Question yourself honestly: is it sensible to waste your time thus? Arise, awake — it is not too late.

definition.citation: Time is God — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 24 (1991), 1991-01-01
definition.quote: Time is the embodiment of God. … The sages have described God as Kalaroopaya (the embodiment of Time).

discourses.citation: Develop Love for God — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-08-18
discourses.quote: Time is the most important and precious power that God has given man. Time is very, very important. Don't waste time. Time waste is life waste. Time is God.

discourses.citation: Give up selfishness and strive for selfrealisation — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 39 (2006), 2006-09-27
discourses.quote: Time waste is life waste! Time is God, don't waste time. Even the little time at your disposal must be spent in contemplation on the Soham (I am God) mantra. Only then will your birth as a human being be sanctified.

discourses.citation: Right use of Time — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 30 (1997), 1997-04-07
discourses.quote: People should realise the preciousness of Time. Most of the time available is wasted by people. This is utterly wrong. Time should be used always for right purposes. That is the foremost duty of every man. Waste of time is waste of life.

discourses.citation: Recognise your Divine Identity — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 30 (1997), 1997-11-23
discourses.quote: Do not waste Time. Time is God. The scriptures have extolled many ways God as the Master of Time. Time wasted is life wasted.

make_it_real: Time is God wearing a watch — spend the next hour as if you were spending Him.
title: Sanctity of Time
